text:
maya: quick RFC follow-up: propose two compact runtime primitives for safe low-bit serving: (1) a versioned 'quality envelope' (acceptance thresholds + fallback ledger with costs) and (2) an entropy-aware per-tenant 'safety budget' counter consumed per-token. runtime can make lockless O(1) decisions.
li: high level ok. one-liner: how are envelope vs budget different?
maya: envelope = auditable policy (loss_pct, coherency_drop, canary rules, fallback order + cost/latency weights). budget = ephemeral runtime quota used to throttle risky low-bit usage locally without remote calls. envelope informs initial budgets and refill rates.
zach: perf note: budget ops must be atomic ints per worker. no heap, no locks. use atomic fetch_sub and saturating math. store small token_cost table per-mode.
ron: tenant safety: how do we avoid noisy tenant stealing capacity?
maya: budgets keyed tenant+worker; we enforce per-tenant max_budget and eviction events. control-plane sets default caps; tenants can request higher budgets with approver_id and approval window. overrides are audited.
li: what about multi-objective routing (cost vs latency vs quality)?
maya: ledger entries include cost_penalty and latency_ms. router computes a small score = alpha*cost_penalty + beta*latency_ms + huge_penalty_if_quality_violated. pick lowest-score fallback that doesn't violate envelope thresholds. simple linear scoring enough.
zach: traceability: include reason codes in traces: e.g., BUDGET_EXHAUST, METRIC_VIOLATION, OVERRIDE. also emit envelope_version and chosen_fallback.
maya: yes. also publish envelope both as human JSON (auditable) and a compact mmap-able binary blob for runtimes. blob small (<1kb) versioned.
ron: RBAC?
maya: safety_level enum (STRICT|CANARY|EXPERIMENTAL). only SRE+Platform can set EXPERIMENTAL globally. tenant EXPERIMENTAL requests require signed justification and ops ack; recorded as approver_id + override_reason.
li: can you paste a tiny example envelope (human-readable)?
maya: sure: {profile_id:llama-3b-fp8-v1, safety:CANARY, loss_pct:1.2, coherency:0.6, ledger:[{mode:fp8,cost:0,lat_ms:0,weight:1},{mode:int8,cost:0.12,lat_ms:2,weight:3},{mode:4bit,cost:0.35,lat_ms:6,weight:6},{mode:fp32,cost:0.6,lat_ms:12,weight:0}], canary_pct:1, auto_rb_loss_pct:2.5, rollback_window_min:30}
zach: impl tasks?
maya: actions: maya write schema + API PR (48h), zach prototype lockless budget counter + mmap blob reader (72h), ron draft RBAC + playbook (48h), li add telemetry fields + dashboards (24h). ops-bot: created ticket 8922: "quant-envelope+safety-budget: schema + runtime blob + telemetry"
li: last ask: add hysteresis to fallback transitions so we don't thrash between modes on short spikes.
maya: yes: envelope fields hysteresis_up_pct and hysteresis_down_pct. runtime applies simple cooldown window per-request-session. thanks all :rocket:
